srs: The search result view system records User, ResultView, ViewService, and CaseSummary; each has an id attribute. Each User can have zero or more ResultView records, and each ResultView belongs to exactly one User. Each ResultView uses exactly one ViewService, and each ViewService serves zero or more ResultView records. Each ViewService manages one or more CaseSummary records by composition, and each CaseSummary belongs to exactly one ViewService. Each User can reference zero or more CaseSummary records, and each CaseSummary can be referenced by zero or more User records.
